# 2 Baruch Chapter 9 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Fall of Jerusalem

---

**9:1** And I Baruch came and sat down before the gate of the temple and wept and mourned, and I cried out and said: "O Lord, why have you set fire to your vineyard and laid waste to your land, and why have you given to destruction the plantation of your right hand?

**9:2** And all the prophets of your people who are left are being led away into captivity, and there is no one left here to comfort your servant Baruch."

---

*SOPHIA notes: LOGOS base throughout. "Plantation of your right hand" (v.1) preserved over PNEUMA's "garden you planted with your own hand" — the Psalm 80:15 allusion requires the more literal rendering. "Your servant Baruch" retained as the formal self-designation.*
